rows.name: QOwnNotes desktop + QOwnNotes Android using a synchronized local note folder
rows.reason: macOS/Android Markdown files support tags/editing through separate folder sync. Tags reside in notes.sqlite, not inline hashtags; sync that file too. Android local-folder documentation postdates question.

rows.name: TagSpaces
rows.reason: TagSpaces verifies file tagging, Markdown viewing and Android, supporting independent note organization. Exact Markdown editing, macOS packaging and tag-storage representation remain unverified; this is only a partial fit.

rows.name: NotePerformer
rows.reason: NotePerformer provides orchestral score playback for Sibelius, Dorico and Finale, not personal-note storage, tagging or editing. The mismatch follows documented operations rather than the shared word note.

rows.name: NixNote2 with Evernote synchronization
rows.reason: NixNote2 with Evernote synchronization still sends notes through Evernote, conflicting with leaving that company. Open-source licensing does not resolve this workflow mismatch; undocumented platform/format failures are not inferred.

rows.name: Obsidian
rows.reason: Obsidian fits local Markdown/tags, but not August 2016: release March 2020, mobile July 2021, Live Preview November 2021. Mac requirements, source license and Android Dropbox syncing remain unverified.

rows.name: Joplin
rows.reason: macOS/Android notes support tags/Markdown editing with local SQLite storage, not individual working Markdown files. Tags are separate metadata; Markdown/front-matter export preserves portable tag names.

rows.name: Joplin
rows.reason: Open-source Mac/Android notes with Markdown editing, tags and portable Markdown-plus-YAML export; retain as a later candidate, since verified export evidence dates to 2021.

rows.name: Joplin
rows.reason: macOS/Android notes document tags, Markdown editing, local SQLite and tag-preserving Markdown exports. Individual files are optional; database storage does not violate open-format requirement. Historical features unverified.

rows.name: nvALT with independently synced plain-text files
rows.reason: nvALT offers Mac Markdown editing, tags and preview with an independently chosen Android editor. Current Finder tags are not automatically portable; 2016 hashtags unestablished. Version 3.0 removes Simplenote sync.

rows.name: QOwnNotes with a synced Markdown folder and an Android editor
rows.reason: Markdown ownership/desktop tags with 2016 Android sync/editor workflow; generic editor lacks proven desktop-tag UI. Filename tags documented; current @tags needs #hashtag adaptation, cutoff unverified. Native Android app postdates question.

rows.name: Simplenote
rows.reason: Simplenote provides tagged Mac/Android notes, not shared-folder Markdown editing. Cutoff Mac Markdown and body hashtags unverified; current Android exports JSON, and Mac export requires Electron.

rows.name: Simplenote
rows.reason: Tagged Markdown with desktop/mobile access and JSON export. Independent live-data access or recovery after account/service failure unestablished; export alone is insufficient. Tags differ from note-body hashtags.

rows.name: NixNote2 with Evernote synchronization
rows.reason: Still synchronizes with Evernote, retaining the provider dependency the question rejects; the repository describes a Linux client, not a Mac/Android Markdown-file replacement.

rows.name: NotePerformer
rows.reason: Music-score playback for Sibelius, Dorico and Finale; it provides no note-taking, Markdown storage, tagging or Mac/Android personal-notes workflow.

rows.name: Joplin
rows.reason: Joplin offers open-source macOS/Android Markdown, tags, Evernote import, offline access and sync. Ordinary editable-file storage and body hashtags remain unverified; live undated docs do not establish August 2016 availability.
